sentences.text: What happens... if Earth suddenly stops spinning?
Without even noticing, you're moving incredibly fast.
At the equator, Earth spins at about one thousand six hundred seventy kilometers per hour!
If Earth stopped suddenly, everything not firmly attached, people, cars, even houses, would be thrown at that speed.
The air would keep moving too, creating winds stronger than any hurricane in history.
Then, the oceans would flow toward the poles.
Water would gather in the north and south, while one giant continent rises around the middle of the planet.
And a day would no longer be twenty-four hours.
The side facing the sun would have six months of daylight, while the other side would freeze in six months of darkness!
But don't worry... scientists say Earth won't suddenly stop spinning.
Which part scares you the most?
